create_skill: create a new Anthropic skill via POST /v1/skills with display title and uploaded files
list_skills: list Anthropic skills via GET /v1/skills with optional limit, after_id, and before_id pagination
get_skill: retrieve a specific Anthropic skill by ID via GET /v1/skills/{skill_id}
delete_skill: delete an Anthropic skill by ID via DELETE /v1/skills/{skill_id}
review_skills_endpoints: review the Anthropic Skills API endpoints module for multi-account model routing support
